title: Create a token
subtitle: You sign the launch in your own wallet. It is listed here only after Minthouse has checked the result on chain.

unavailable.title: No networks are open for launches
unavailable.body: The API and this app don't currently share a network you can launch on.

bsc-erc20.title: BNB Chain
bsc-erc20.body: An ERC-20 with a supply you choose.

solana-spl.title: Solana SPL
solana-spl.body: A standard SPL token with on-chain metadata.

pumpfun.title: Pump.fun
pumpfun.body: A bonding curve on the official Pump program.

fields.name: Name
fields.supplyHint: Whole tokens. They are issued to the recipient in the creation transaction.
fields.recipientHint: Leave blank to send the supply to the connected wallet.
fields.logoHint: Square PNG, JPEG, or WebP, at least {{size}} pixels.
fields.mintingHint: The owner can mint more until minting is permanently disabled.
fields.initialBuyHint: Optional. Bought in the same transaction as the launch. Zero means no buy.
fields.pumpSupply: Supply and decimals are fixed by Pump.fun: 1,000,000,000 tokens, 6 decimals. Mint authority is removed.

wallet.title: Choose a wallet
wallet.body: Minthouse never sees your keys. The wallet shows the transaction before you sign it.
wallet.empty: No Solana wallet was found in this browser.

success.title: {{name}} is verified
success.body: The chain matches what you requested, so the token is listed.

errors.title: The launch did not finish
errors.wallet: Connect the wallet that should create this token.
errors.logo: Add a PNG, JPEG, or WebP logo.
errors.logoSmall: Logo must be at least {{size}} pixels on each side.
errors.logoRead: That image could not be read.
errors.chain: Switch your wallet to {{network}} before creating the token.

warnings.mainnet: This is {{network}}. The transaction spends real {{symbol}} and cannot be taken back.
warnings.mainnetConfirm: I understand this creates a real token
warnings.storage: Logo and metadata are stored temporarily on this server. Public explorers and Pump.fun may not be able to load them.
